rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for referring to the beginning of something.

example.english: At the outset, we made it clear that we wouldn't go to that restaurant.
example.traditional: 一開始我哋就講明今次旅行唔去嗰間餐廳。
example.jyutping: jat1 hoi1 ci2 ngo5 dei6 zau6 gong2 ming4 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 m4 heoi3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the initial part or early stage of something rather than simply marking when it began.

example.english: At the outset, the first few pages were a bit boring, and it only got good later.
example.traditional: 開頭嗰幾頁有啲悶，後面先至好睇。
example.jyutping: hoi1 tau4 go2 gei2 jip6 jau5 di1 mun6 hau6 min6 sin1 zi3 hou2 tai2
